description: A room that serves coltrane's own MCP server from inside the container, equipping exactly one tool. NOTE ON THE COMMAND FIELD, which is not what it appears: the containerized emission does not run this command. Every stdio server in a realized room is reached as `docker exec … node /app/dist/src/server_entry.js` regardless of what the contract declares — and declaring that real path here is REFUSED by the renderer's value scan as an absolute host path outside the per-realization directory. So the honest declaration is unrepresentable and this placeholder stands in its place. That contradiction between the contract field and the emission is a known defect, recorded here rather than papered over.
